question: Where did the final of the 2016 Hockey Junior World Cup take place?
solution: The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **2016 Hockey Junior World Cup** final was held at **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**, India. • This prestigious tournament is organized by the **International Hockey Federation (FIH)** and features the participation of top junior teams from across the globe. • The **final match** took place at the **Major Dhyan Chand Stadium**, a renowned venue named after the legendary Indian hockey player. • The tournament witnessed the participation of 16 teams, showcasing young talent and future stars of field hockey. • In the final match, **India defeated Belgium** to win the championship, marking a historic moment for Indian hockey.
